lines.explanation: Read-only query; agent retrieved actual channel_name for each of the four supplied channel IDs via conversations.info and correctly found none equals exactly "security" (security-ops, sec-alerts, audit-log, incident-response), matching the initial_state channel records. It correctly reported absence of any workspace with a channel named exactly "security" among the four, without substituting an unrelated channel/workspace as a match. The task requested only listing workspaces among these four channels, and the agent answered accordingly.
